picks.editorial_note: MIT and UBC researchers built a single deep-learning model that simulates wildly different physical phenomena—from sand to folding proteins—suggesting a unifying approach to physics simulation that could accelerate materials science, biology, and engineering simulation alike.
picks.title: A single AI model simulates the behavior of many substances, from sliding sand to folding proteins

picks.editorial_note: Cambridge's AI-guided vaccine design technique achieved complete protection against diverse circulating bird flu variants in animal trials, pointing toward a faster, more resilient path for pandemic preparedness.
picks.title: Scientists are using AI to develop superior vaccines against viruses threatening global health

picks.editorial_note: Tel Aviv and Stanford researchers showed AI models can learn general predictive skills from purely synthetic, self-generated data rather than real-world observation—a fundamental finding that could reshape how future AI systems are trained.
picks.title: AI Learns to Predict the World Without Ever Seeing It

picks.editorial_note: An NIH-funded, Case Western-led multi-institutional team will combine satellite imaging, health records, and AI to probe how environmental exposures drive Alzheimer's and dementia—a large-scale federal investment at the intersection of AI and public health.
picks.title: Case Western Reserve-led team to study how the environment contributes to Alzheimer’s and dementia | CWRU Newsroom | Case Western Reserve University

picks.editorial_note: TUM's new Munich site for Germany's Center for Future Mobility, backed by up to €20 million in federal funding, will pilot autonomous public transportation at scale—a major government bet on AI-driven mobility infrastructure.
picks.title: Autonomous Public Transportation: TUM Opens New DZM Location in Munich

picks.editorial_note: HKUST's MoU with robotics maker Unitree, anchored around a planned joint laboratory, signals deepening academia-industry convergence on embodied AI and robotics commercialization in a highly competitive field.
picks.title: HKUST and Unitree Sign MoU to Advance Embodied AI and Robotics Collaboration
picks.university: Hong Kong Univ. of Science and Technology

picks.editorial_note: Atos and Inria's strategic partnership to push research into sovereign industrial AI applications—spanning physical AI, agentic AI, and cybersecurity—reflects Europe's push for technological independence in critical AI infrastructure.
picks.title: Atos and Inria enter into a strategic partnership to accelerate the transfer of research into sovereign industrial applications

picks.editorial_note: A $4.2 million NIST award will let SMU build a Digital Twin Technology Lab applying AI and robotics to semiconductor manufacturing and workforce training, directly supporting US chip-sector competitiveness goals.
picks.title: SMU awarded $4.2 million to advance AI-driven manufacturing and workforce training

picks.editorial_note: Google.org funding will let ANU modernize a widely used fusion simulation tool with AI, a concrete example of industry philanthropy accelerating clean-energy science.
picks.title: ANU receives Google funding to boost fusion energy research with AI

picks.editorial_note: A TU Wien/ICREA study of a real recidivism-risk algorithm used in Catalonia's justice system found that equally accurate models can yield very different predictions for the same individuals—a cautionary finding for any government deploying AI in high-stakes decisions.
picks.title: In case of doubt, opt for the lower risk
